title: Al-'Alaq 96:13-16 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 2: Al-'Alaq 13 to 19, At-Tin and meem sakinah
source: Written for quran/y3 lesson 18 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Al-'Alaq 96:13-16 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 18. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: أَرَءَيْتَ إِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰٓ (١٣) أَلَمْ يَعْلَم بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَرَىٰ (١٤) كَلَّا لَئِن لَّمْ يَنتَهِ لَنَسْفَعًۢا بِٱلنَّاصِيَةِ (١٥) نَاصِيَةٍۢ كَٰذِبَةٍ خَاطِئَةٍۢ (١٦)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: Have you seen if he denies and turns away -
Does he not know that Allah sees?
No! If he does not desist, We will surely drag him by the forelock -

head: Word
Where
Rule
How to read it
rows: Close the lips on the meem, then a clear yaa
Idgham without ghunnah: ن into ل
Merge the noon straight into the laam
Small meem: lips close, hum two counts

keywords.def: the forelock, the front of the head
a meem with no vowel (a sukoon or no mark)

questions.q: Chunk and link Al-'Alaq 96:13-16 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 96:13-16 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Which word has a meem with a sukoon?
Listening rota: today's group recites 96:13-16 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: On the pupil PDF, underline the tanween in 96:15 and 96:16 and name the rule for each.
questions.a: لَنَسْفَعًۢا بِ: iqlab; نَاصِيَةٍۢ كَٰذِبَةٍ: ikhfa (ك); كَٰذِبَةٍ خَاطِئَةٍۢ: izhar (خ).

questions.q: Recite 96:1 to 16 in one go to a partner in a breakout room. Note one place you paused.
questions.a: Pupil recites 96:1 to 16; partner notes one pause or slip.

questions.q: In 96:14, Allah tells us that He ...
questions.a: A) sees. 96:14: 'Does he not know that Allah sees?' Allah sees everything and never sleeps or forgets.

questions.q: Al-'Alaq 96:14: «أَلَمْ يَعْلَم ...» Which word comes next?
Think again: Allah asks: 'Does he not know that Allah sees?' (96:14). How would you act today if you remembered this all day?
questions.a: We would be honest and kind even when no one else is watching, because Allah always sees.
